name: Reading the Screen
summary: Find Life, RF, SP, combo Power, and the juggle gauge.
description: Find Life, RF, SP, combo Power, and the juggle gauge.

pages.title: Life and Rounds
pages.text: Each {term:Life Gauge} is at the top. Everyone starts with the same life, and the marks beside it show rounds won. EFZ has no round timer: the number in the middle is {term:FPS}, normally 64 under Revival.

pages.title: SP and RF
pages.text: At the bottom, the large {term:SP Gauge} stores up to three Super levels. The smaller {term:RF Gauge} below it powers RF Attacks and Instant Charge. You will practice both later.

pages.title: Combos and Juggles
pages.text: During a combo, the display shows hits, damage, and {term:Power}. Power affects damage and how long later hits can keep the opponent airborne. A separate gauge appears under a juggled character and changes color as their chance to recover gets close.

pages.title: Character Resources
pages.text: Some characters have an extra meter of their own. That character's guide explains how it works.
